mapper.sql: h.uuid as "uuid", h.organization_uuid as "organizationUuid", h.project_uuid as "projectUuid", h.branch_uuid as "branchUuid", h.branch_key as "branchKey", h.branch_type as "branchType", h.base_branch_key as "baseBranchKey", h.issue_key as "issueKey", h.rule_uuid as "ruleUuid", h.rule_key as "ruleKey", h.component_key as "componentKey", h.line as "line", h.message as "message", h.severity as "severity", h.issue_type as "issueType", h.clean_code_attribute as "cleanCodeAttribute", h.impacts as "impacts", h.tags as "tags", h.author_login as "authorLogin", h.assignee_uuid as "assigneeUuid", h.effort as "effort", h.issue_status as "issueStatus", h.status as "status", h.resolution as "resolution", h.issue_creation_date as "issueCreationDate", h.issue_close_date as "issueCloseDate", h.captured_at as "capturedAt", h.captured_by as "capturedBy", h.captured_by_uuid as "capturedByUuid"
mapper.insert: insert into cs_tracked_issue ( uuid, organization_uuid, project_uuid, branch_uuid, branch_key, branch_type, base_branch_key, issue_key, rule_uuid, rule_key, component_key, line, message, severity, issue_type, clean_code_attribute, impacts, tags, author_login, assignee_uuid, effort, issue_status, status, resolution, issue_creation_date, issue_close_date, captured_at, captured_by, captured_by_uuid ) values ( #{dto.uuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.organizationUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.branchType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.baseBranchKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.ruleUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.ruleKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.componentKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.line, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{dto.message, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.severity, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.cleanCodeAttribute, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.impacts, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.tags, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.authorLogin, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.assigneeUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.effort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{dto.issueStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.resolution, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.issueCreationDate, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{dto.issueCloseDate, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{dto.capturedAt, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{dto.capturedBy, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dto.capturedByUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: select h.branch_key as "branchKey", h.branch_type as "branchType", max(h.base_branch_key) as "baseBranchKey", case when max(pb.uuid) is null then ${_false} else ${_true} end as "active", count(1) as "issueCount" from cs_tracked_issue h left join project_branches pb on pb.project_uuid = h.project_uuid and pb.kee = h.branch_key and pb.branch_type = h.branch_type where h.project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by h.branch_key, h.branch_type order by h.branch_type, h.branch_key
mapper.delete: delete from cs_tracked_issue where project_uuid = #{projectUuid, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
